experiment_design.weights_status: manual prototype weights; not trained or optimized
experiment_design.data_origin: synthetic deterministic test data; not real ExecutionAgent bids and not SMPL measurements
limitations: assignment success rate is trivially 100% because every trial supplies three valid bids
no wall-clock bid timeout or asynchronous communication is measured
no environment execution reward or task completion outcome is measured
the experiment compares selection behavior only, not end-to-end system performance
